verdict.rationale: Letta's docs reference a dedicated pricing page with a free tier (up to 20 stateful agents, BYOK-based free start) and a 'developer plan' with usage-based pricing, which suggests per-unit billing exists, but no evidence shows actual per-unit rate figures (e.g., $/GB memory, $/agent-hour) that would let a platform engineer project memory costs precisely. Missing for 10: explicit per-unit price figures/rate tables, memory-specific cost breakdown, and independent corroboration of the pricing page's accuracy.
